verdict.rationale: Drata ships a Public APIv2 with OAuth and documented endpoints across many core domains: Personnel, Devices, Custom Connections, Monitoring Tests, Controls, Policies (including create), Risks, Audits and Trust Center management, plus an official MCP server for agents. However, nothing in the evidence claims or shows UI parity. Most documented endpoints are list/read operations, and UI features such as Risk Assessment workflows and Trust Center analytics are not shown to be API-exposed. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, evidence of write/update coverage across all domains (risk assessment, policy center workflows, trust center analytics), and independent hands-on corroboration of coverage.
